description: Browses and selects icons from the available libraries.

attributes.name: compact
attributes.description: Shows only the title, filters, and a compact 2em icon grid.

attributes.name: filter
attributes.description: Free-text filter applied to icon names/libraries.

events.name: tp-icon-picker-copy-error
events.description: Emitted when copying the selected icon fails. The detail contains the requested clipboard text, selection metadata and the caught error.
events.detail: { name: string; library: string; format: TpIconPickerCopyFormat; value: string; error: unknown }

events.name: tp-icon-picker-select
events.description: Emitted when a icon is selected. The detail contains the selection metadata and requested clipboard text; this event does not confirm clipboard success.
events.detail: { name: string; library: string; sourcePath: string; format: TpIconPickerCopyFormat; value: string }

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-icon-picker>` element browses and selects icons from the available libraries.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Browse or search the available items, then select one to copy it in the chosen format. |
| Using the component | Use the displayed filters and format selector, when available, to narrow the list or change the copied representation. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| Focused controls | Use each control’s standard keyboard interaction.  |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
